content:
sara (prod): quick async check — milestone pass for Q3 OKR 'reduce inference latency'

sara (prod): what shipped: canary for runtime-v2 (10% traffic) is live, baseline latency down ~12% on internal tests :tada:

dan (eng): nice. I pulled canary logs — one noisy 502 pattern at ~09:14, looks like a short OOM on a worker

leo (frontend): shipped the prompt-edit UI that relies on the new runtime flags. integrated canary endpoint and smoke tested. e2e failing on two flows (session restore) — suspect KV cache mismatch

anita (eng-infra): KV config drift is real — infra change to align cache ttl is in review (PR #483). ETA Tue morning if approvals go well

morgan (design): design followups for the UI small; left two copy nits in Figma comments, can fix within an afternoon

dan (eng): owners + next actions:
- dan: investigate 502/OOM chain, probably related to batching window (assigning to myself)
- anita: land KV TTL config change (PR #483) and coordinate with dan for rollout
- leo: reproduce e2e failures and create minimal repro; hold on merging any fix until infra TTL is stable

sara (prod): dependency notes: prompt-edit feature depends on PR #483 landing and dan's fix. we should gate full rollout until both done. canary stays at 10%

dan (eng): quick asks: can folks please ping reviewers on #eng-prs for PR #483 and my PR #487 (batching tweak)? blocked on reviews

leo (frontend): pinging reviewers now. also will add a unit test that reproduces session restore; should help reviewers be confident

anita (eng-infra): CI shows flakiness on the infra job — ci-bot noted job 23 failing intermittently

ci-bot: Build 2026-03-17-23 failed: job=infra-integ, step=kv-sync, exit=1\```
KV sync timeout after 30s
stack: redis-sync -> config-push -> healthcheck
``` 
ci-bot: retry queued by anita (attempt 2)

dan (eng): logging improvement: i'm going to add a short debug span around batching op to capture input shapes. will keep it behind a flag

morgan (design): timeline impact? if infra lands Tue and dan's fix is early Tue, can we aim for broader rollout Wed morning?

sara (prod): yes — plan: keep canary at 10% until Wed 10:00 UTC, then increment to 40% if no new regressions. if any blocker persists, we roll back canary and file postmortem

dan (eng): cr pings: @eng on #eng-prs for PR #487 and PR #483 — small diffs, high impact; please review today if you can

leo (frontend): FYI — the prompt-edit telemetry will only start after 40% traffic, so metrics for UX won't be meaningful until Wed after the ramp

anita (eng-infra): tagging owners for deployment window: i'll schedule the infra rollout Tue 04:00 UTC (quiet window). dan, can you be available for post-deploy validation?

dan (eng): yep, I'll stand by during validation window

sara (prod): outstanding risks:
- KV TTL drift causing session restore slips (in progress)
- subtle batching edge-case causing occasional OOMs (dan investigating)
- e2e gaps on frontend until infra stable

sara (prod): doc link: https://redwood.ai/okrs/q3/milestones (updated with current status and owners)

morgan (design): thanks — left comments on the doc for measurement targets

dan (eng): i'll post a short follow-up with the debug logs once I have more; expect update by EOD PST

leo (frontend): CR done for my tiny UI tweak, left one question, over to dan/anita for infra-related gating

anita (eng-infra): re: CI instability — if job 23 keeps failing i'll open infra incident and revert the last infra roll; for now retry seems green

ci-bot: Retry 2026-03-17-23 success: job=infra-integ, duration=4m12s

sara (prod): summary / next steps:
- keep canary at 10%
- anita land PR #483 Tue early morning
- dan finish debug + PR #487, post logs EOD PST
- leo hold merge until infra lands, add repro test
- morgan finish minor copy fixes
- sara will update milestone doc and re-sync Fri if any slip remains

sara (prod): if anyone is blocked and needs a synchronous huddle, say so — otherwise we'll proceed async. :thumbsup:

dan (eng): thanks all — pinged reviewers

leo (frontend): thanks, will follow up with repro and keep you posted

anita (eng-infra): scheduling infra rollout and will update the doc when done

morgan (design): :thumbsup:
